# Laura Clarke Administrative Services

> Independent, private document concierge based in St. Catherine, Jamaica. We pre-audit paperwork against each agency's counter rules and file or collect documents at PICA, TAJ, RGD, JCF and ITA for clients in Jamaica and overseas (US, UK, Canada). We are not a government agency and are not affiliated with the Government of Jamaica. Government fees are paid to the agency and are separate from our concierge retainer.

Contact: WhatsApp +1 (876) 561-2614 (https://wa.me/18765612614), info@documenthelpja.com. Requirements and fees on this site were last checked September 2026.

## Services (homepage directory with requirements, government fees and retainers)

- [All services](https://documenthelpja.com/#services): passports, citizenship by descent, TRN, driver's licence, motor vehicle licence, driving abstracts, police records, RGD certificates, apostilles
- [Adult passport renewal, no name change](https://documenthelpja.com/passport-renewal-no-name-change.html): online PICA renewal; PICA fee JMD 6,500 plus JMD 5,000 retainer
- [Adult passport renewal, with name change](https://documenthelpja.com/passport-renewal-name-change.html)
- [Minor (under 18) passport renewal](https://documenthelpja.com/passport-minor-renewal.html)
- [Lost, stolen or damaged passport](https://documenthelpja.com/passport-lost-stolen-damaged.html)
